COD.note: Hydro-powered and called efficient on PUE, but no feed, substation, plant or PUE figure is stated.

facts.fact: Actualite.cd reports OADC Texaf Digital-Kinshasa, a 2 MW carrier-neutral colocation data centre, went into service in August 2024 and is Uptime Institute Tier-III certified.

COD.note: Only a passing mention of the president's national digital plan; no standing, text or period stated.
Peering ecosystem described as intended; no exchange point stated in service.
Identification is named only as a possible service.
2Africa is said to have landed at Moanda but is not stated in service.
Nothing on standards bodies or adopted standards.
Ownership split between OADC and TEXAF not stated, so national ownership is not settled.
Nothing on a national standards body; the Uptime certificate is a foreign certification.
No startup law or fund stated.
Silikin Village is called a digital hub but no programme or tenants are stated.
